name: Line chart
what: A line that draws itself: a chart whose lines rise with a dot riding each tip and the end value popping; a wavy journey with milestones popping and a flag; or a heartbeat line drawing across.

learned_from.what: one line rising across a light chart, a dot on its tip
two curves rising with a picture on each tip
a wavy line with milestone dots ending on a red flag
a heartbeat line drawing across black

motion: grid 14 f; the line draws 70 f (S-curve), the tip rides it; milestones back.out 10 f as the line reaches them; the flag waves
